verdict.rationale: Supabase documents branching as isolated environments, with preview environments per pull request, for testing database schema changes without affecting production. Its official MCP server gives agents `create_branch`, `merge_branch`, `reset_branch`, `rebase_branch` and `delete_branch` alongside `apply_migration`. The MCP security guidance explicitly recommends branching so agents can test changes safely before merging, and a local CLI MCP endpoint offers a second isolated path. missing for 10: MCP branching tools are labeled experimental, no hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent completing a full branch-migrate-test-merge workflow, and test-execution details on branches are thin.
